notes: Raise the gable out of the crown: its fillet pinches to 0.02 mm at 162 of 871 stations, smallest at 66.2° round the ring, r 11.85 z 1.00 mm in its section, point (4.78, 10.85, 1.00) mm
process: neither clean at the draft check

notes: Field-sampled: the surface itself carries no undercut at this parting.
Judged with the ring as built: 7 CAD parts (3 joined, 4 cut) at the parting plane z = +0.00 mm — 869.1 mm² of part surface, 0.1 mm² of it undercut.

Extrude "Raise the gable out of the crown" (#7): 0.1 mm² of undercut leaning to -83° on flanks facing back across the parting plane, 45–135°, 1.5 mm toward the low edge to 1.5 mm toward the high edge — stage it Bench to solder it on after the pour (the pattern keeps a locating mark), or move it onto the parting line.
With its CAD parts 25.4% of the ring carries less than 3.0 deg of draft or stands parallel to the pull — it releases, but drags on the sand.

summary: 6 x 2.6 band carrying a vertical wheel 15 mm across and 3 thick, proud of a pointed gable rising out of the crown: 12 lancets on 0.80 mm spokes round a hub, 12 quatrefoils 1.4 mm across, pierced through; the rim in two orders.
